name: Yamabe no Akahito
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 4); Porter’s note gives the dates as: lived c. 700.

poems.title: I started off along the shore
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 4
poems.text:
I started off along the shore,
The sea shore at Tago,
And saw the white and glist’ning peak
Of Fuji all aglow
Through falling flakes of snow.

poems.title: 4. 田子の浦に 打出でてみれば 白妙の (Tago no ura ni uchiidete mireba shirotae no)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 新古今集
poems.text:
田子の浦に 打出でてみれば 白妙の
ふじの高嶺に 雪は降りつつ

poems.title: MYS 318: 田子の浦ゆ打ち出て見れば (Tago no ura yu uchiidete mireba)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 3. Hanka (envoy) to Akahito's chōka on viewing Mount Fuji (MYS 317); the headnote names Yamabe no Akahito. This is the Man'yōshū form of the poem held in this file as Hyakunin Isshu 4, a different text (the Shin kokinshū version is given above).
poems.text: 田子の浦ゆ打ち出て見れば真白くそ不盡の高嶺に雪は降りける

poems.title: MYS 358: 武庫の浦を榜ぎ廻む小舟 (Muko no ura o kogitamu obune)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 3. One of six poems under the headnote 'Poems by Yamabe no Sukune Akahito': rowing boats off the Muko shore, with Awashima behind.
poems.text: 武庫の浦を榜ぎ廻む小舟粟島を背向に見つつ羨しき小舟

poems.title: MYS 918: 沖つ島荒磯の玉藻 (Okitsu shima arisu no tamamo)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 6. First of two hanka to Akahito's chōka composed when the court travelled to Kii Province in the tenth month of the first year of Jinki (724); the headnote names Yamabe no Sukune Akahito. Left-note: year and month not recorded, said to have been composed on the Tamatsushima journey.
poems.text: 沖つ島荒磯の玉藻潮干満ちてい隠ろひなば思ほえむかも

poems.title: MYS 919: 若の浦に潮満ち来れば (Waka no ura ni shio michikureba)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 6. Second hanka to Akahito's chōka on the Kii journey of 724 (Wakanoura, with cranes crossing to the reed-beds); the headnote names Yamabe no Sukune Akahito.
poems.text: 若の浦に潮満ち来れば潟を無み葦辺をさして鶴鳴き渡る

poems.title: MYS 924: み吉野の象山の際の (Miyoshino no Kisayama no ma no)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 6. First of two hanka to the second of Akahito's Yoshino chōka (the headnote reads 'two poems by Yamabe no Sukune Akahito, with envoys'): birds loud in the treetops at Mount Kisa.
poems.text: み吉野の象山の際の木末にはここだも騒く鳥の声かも

poems.title: MYS 925: ぬば玉の夜の更けぬれば (Nubatama no yo no fukenureba)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 6. Second hanka to the Yoshino chōka under the headnote naming Yamabe no Sukune Akahito: plovers calling at night on the clear river-bed where hisagi trees grow.
poems.text: ぬば玉の夜の更けぬれば久木生ふる清き川原に千鳥しば鳴く

poems.title: MYS 944: 島隠り吾が榜ぎ来れば (Shimagakuri a ga kogikureba)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 6. Second of three hanka to Akahito's chōka composed on passing the island of Karani (headnote: Yamabe no Sukune Akahito): the boat bound for Yamato.
poems.text: 島隠り吾が榜ぎ来れば羨しかも大和へ上る真熊野の船

poems.title: MYS 945: 風吹けば波か立たむと (Kaze fukeba nami ka tatamu to)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 6. Third of three hanka to Akahito's Karani chōka (headnote: Yamabe no Sukune Akahito): waiting out the wind in the inlet at Tsuta.
poems.text: 風吹けば波か立たむと伺候に都太の細江に浦隠り居り

poems.title: MYS 1424: 春の野にすみれ摘みにと (Haru no no ni sumire tsumi ni to)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 8, spring miscellaneous poems. First of four poems under the headnote 'Poems by Yamabe no Sukune Akahito': he came to pick violets and stayed the night in the field.
poems.text: 春の野にすみれ摘みにと来し吾ぞ野をなつかしみ一夜寝にける

poems.title: MYS 1431: 百済野の萩の古枝に (Kudarano no hagi no furue ni)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 8, spring miscellaneous poems. Under the headnote 'A poem by Yamabe no Sukune Akahito': a bush warbler waiting for spring on an old bush-clover branch at Kudarano.
poems.text: 百済野の萩の古枝に春待つと来居し鴬鳴きにけむかも

poems.title: MYS 3915: 足引の山谷越えて (Ashihiki no yama tani koete)
poems.author: Yamabe no Akahito
poems.collection: 万葉集 (Man'yōshū), after Saitō Mokichi, 万葉秀歌
poems.note: Book 17. Under the headnote 'A poem by Yamabe no Sukune Akahito on the spring bush warbler'; the left-note says the date and place cannot be established.
poems.text: 足引の山谷越えて野づかさに今は鳴くらむ鴬の声
